turns.prompt_text: how do you undo the adhesive of a light bulb in order to separate the glass from the metal
turns.response_html:
To separate the glass envelope from the metal base, you must soften the vitreous cement or heat-resistant adhesive holding them together.

Methods for Adhesive Removal

  • Heat Gun Application: Direct a heat gun at the seam where the metal meets the glass for several minutes. Use pliers to gently wiggle the base until the adhesive bond breaks.
  • Chemical Soaking: Submerge the metal base in acetone or a specialized adhesive remover for 24–48 hours to dissolve the cement.
  • Mechanical Scoring: Use a rotary tool with a diamond cutting wheel to carefully score the metal circumference, then pry it away in sections.

Warning: Wear heavy-duty gloves and eye protection. Light bulbs are under vacuum or pressure, and the glass is extremely thin and prone to shattering during manipulation.
